feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 June 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 29 June 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by an area of low pressure and associated frontal zone.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5, increasing occasionally 6 in the west tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving, becoming isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, soon veering northwest 4 or 5, backing west or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers soon becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
